items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the gentleman I was speaking to happened to be a Mason, you know, and I've been one all my life, practically, and so when I came back, he told me that he would let me run the club

ctx.x: instruments and everything was in there, and I told him we were from Los Angeles.

Well, the gentleman I was speaking to happened to be a Mason, you know, and I've been one all my life, practically, and so when I came back, he told me that he would let me run the club, if I paid them -- if I tried to pay the back taxes and I kept it up current.

Now I knew as much about running the club, or running any type of business, you know, that -- just nothing, you know, so I told him I would try it. And I actually tried it. And I did it for, like, 10 weeks -- but there was a partner involved with me, you know, and he was like held over from the other man that he had kicked out, and he blamed everything on the other man, but, somehow, these government people just said they left it up to me to see -- we were supposed to pay them like a thousand dollars a week on…
